analysis.summary: Value 360 Communications successfully completed its initial public offering and listed its shares on the NSE SME Platform on May 11, 2026. On a standalone basis, revenue from operations reached ₹6,245.93 Lakhs with a net profit of ₹900.46 Lakhs, while consolidated revenue from operations grew to ₹6,896.01 Lakhs with a net profit after minority interest of ₹990.34 Lakhs. Management highlighted that the company expanded its footprint across technology, consumer, healthcare, and BFSI sectors, and remains focused on disciplined capital allocation, transparency, and digital-first capabilities. The board did not recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that clients increasingly demand measurable impact, higher trust, and tangible business outcomes rather than visibility alone.
demand_outlook.quote: Clients no longer seek visibility alone; they demand measurable impact — stronger reputations, higher trust, and tangible business outcomes.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the communications industry has undergone a transformation from press releases and media outreach to an integrated digital ecosystem.
demand_outlook.quote: The communications industry in India has undergone a profound transformation in the last decade. What was once dominated by press releases and media outreach has now become an integrated ecosystem spanning digital storytelling, influencer engagement, crisis management, public policy, and data-driven reputation management.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors did not recommend any dividend on equity shares for the financial year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors have not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹3,752.62 lakhs through a fresh issue of 38,29,200 equity shares in its Initial Public Offer.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company successfully made its Initial Public Offer (‘IPO’) of 1,60,90,008 Equity Shares @ ₹98/- (including a share premium of ₹88/-) per equity share of ₹10/- each, which includes a fresh issue of 38,29,200 Equity Shares of ₹10/- each for raising funds for the Company to the tune of ₹3,752.62 lakhs and an offer for sale by the selling shareholder of 4,24,800 Equity Shares of face value of ₹10/- each of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to delivering responsible growth, maintaining stakeholder trust, and creating enduring value.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, we remain committed to delivering responsible growth, maintaining the trust of our stakeholders, and creating enduring value for everyone associated with Value 360.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to help shape the digital transformation and evolving communications landscape.
management_commitments.quote: At Value 360, we do not intend to simply adapt to this transformation—we aspire to help shape it.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
